description: Every Obsidian CLI feature, plus protocol-aware frontmatter enforcement, instant offline FTS5 search, and token-efficient agent reads no other Obsidian tool ships.
auth_description:
The CLI defaults to filesystem mode and needs no token. Set OBSIDIAN_REST_TOKEN
only when using --rest mode, which proxies through the coddingtonbear/obsidian-local-rest-api
community plugin (the Obsidian app must be running with the plugin enabled).

novel_features.name: Protocol lint
novel_features.description: Walks the vault and reports frontmatter violations with severity tiers, encoding the three-layer-memory protocol rules used by the UCE pipeline.

novel_features.name: Auto-migrate violations
novel_features.description: Fixes the mechanical subset of lint violations: ISO date coercion, type enum normalization, fill missing description from body.

novel_features.name: Three-layer dashboard
novel_features.description: Counts of notes per memory layer (Knowledge Graph / Events / Patterns) with type breakdown, average age, and recent-write velocity.

novel_features.name: Fact graduation candidates
novel_features.description: Lists entities whose inline fact count is approaching or past the 20-fact threshold for graduation to a TOML sidecar file.

novel_features.name: Decision-trace tracker
novel_features.description: Given a decision_trace_id, returns every fact across the vault that cites it, ordered by timestamp.

novel_features.name: Entity dossier
novel_features.description: Joins notes + frontmatter + facts + backlinks + tags for one entity into a single agent-readable block.

novel_features.name: cm extraction-readiness audit
novel_features.description: Filters lint findings to the rule subset that the downstream cm extraction pipeline depends on (missing description, missing type, bad date format).

novel_features.name: Stale notes by type
novel_features.description: Lists notes whose mtime predates a threshold, optionally filtered by type.

novel_features.name: Provenance audit
novel_features.description: Reads source frontmatter on a note plus the source field on every fact in that note; prints a chain showing where each datum came from.

novel_features.name: Daily note append
novel_features.description: Resolves today's daily-note path, creates it from the periodic-note template (with protocol-compliant frontmatter) if missing, and appends under a named section.
